result_text:
The warehouse stock list no longer shows products with nothing left. The full suite passes (608 tests, 0 failures).

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`** (`findStockLevelsByWarehouse`, ~line 2107): added `AND s.quantity > 0` to the query and changed its Javadoc, which had said zero quantities were included on purpose.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockOverviewTest.java`**: added `warehouseStockLeavesOutProductsWithNothingLeft`. It takes all nuts out of WH-1, sets screws to 0, and checks that the list shows only "Bolt 10" and that the nut quantity is still 0.

`StockService.getQuantity` was not changed, so a missing or zero stock row still answers 0. Nothing is committed.
